messages:
incident-bot: Pager: embed-service p99 latency > 2s for 2m. Alerting oncall @Sam. links: https://inc.example/1976543210 (auto-generated)
Sam: oncall here. I see a latency spike across embed-prod shards. Rolling mitigation: autoscaler bump + quick rollback of last deploy (sha abc123). Will update.
Priya: grabbing runbook — checking kv-cache eviction and redis pool saturation. pinging infra metrics.
Sam: mitigation applied (scaled to +3 nodes, rolled back abc123 -> def456). tail latency dropped, 1min stable. marking contained.
Ana: Customer-facing note — CS dashboard shows ~12 customers with transient 502s between 03:10-03:18 UTC. Not seeing long-term failures, clients retried. I'll open a customer impact spreadsheet after handoff.
Mike: product here — saw a spike in retries from mobile clients which amplified load. Might be a feedback loop with client backoff not exponential.
Jess: good containment. Let's hand this to postmortem owners and SRE for remediation items. Proposed postmortem slot: tomorrow 09:00 UTC, 1h. Can Sam draft the timeline and Priya fill infra root cause?
Sam: I can draft timeline. Quick timeline sketch here:
```
03:08 UTC - monitoring alert: p99 > 2s
03:09 UTC - incident-bot paged oncall (Sam)
03:10 UTC - spike correlated with deploy abc123 on embed-worker-3
03:11 UTC - autoscaler bumped, beginning rollback of abc123
03:13 UTC - rollback complete to def456; autoscaler finished scale-up
03:14 UTC - p99 trending down; by 03:16 stable within SLO
```
Priya: infra notes to add: redis connection pool hit 100% on shard-2, GC pauses on worker container increased during spike. I pulled heap dump and logs:
```
ERROR shard-2 redis: connection timeout 100ms x 120
WARN worker-3: blocking GC pause 85ms
```
Priya: early hypothesis = regress from abc123 increased KV cache miss rate, causing higher pressure on redis and longer tails; autoscaler reacted but created transient overload while rolling out.
Taylor: I'll take responsibility for postmortem doc setup (linking runbook + timeline). I'll create action items and track remediation in the incidents board.
Jess: Action items proposed (owners + tentative due dates):
- Add guardrail to autoscaler to avoid simultaneous scale+deploy (owner: Jess, due: 2d)
- Add client-side exponential backoff guidance to mobile SDK (owner: Mike, due: 5d)
- Harden redis pool metrics alert thresholds (owner: Priya, due: 3d)
- Add a quick pre-deploy smoke for kv-cache regression (owner: Sam, due: 4d)
- Postmortem + customer-impact notes (owner: Ana, due: 1d)
Sam: also raising one infra follow-up: investigate GC tuning on embed-worker image; maybe a JDK change introduced more pauses.
Ana: I'll draft customer-impact summary in the doc. No P0 escalations, but a handful of paying customers saw retries. Will include ID list and support tickets.
Priya: for the postmortem, I'll attach the heap dump and redis metrics links. Also recommend a short brown-bag share on preventing tail latency from deploy rollouts.
Mike: +1 to brown-bag. I can present client-side retry patterns and how product throttling interacts. Proposed slot next Wed 16:00 UTC.
Jess: scheduling brown-bag after postmortem. Who can volunteer to co-present? Priya + Mike?
Priya: I can do infra side.
Taylor: putting owners into incidents board now. Creating follow-up tasks and tagging eng-runtime and devex for SDK guidance.
incident-bot: Postmortem checklist created: https://inc.example/pm/1976543210. Reminder: p0 timeline + diffs required before review.
Sam: final notes: please add any additional logs, customer messages, and downstream alerts to the postmortem doc. We'll run the postmortem at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. If anyone can't make it, add notes inline.
Jess: thanks team. I'll run the postmortem and lead the remediation triage. See you tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
